Title: Ishaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ishaan - 10 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Kavita - 41 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Anil - 38 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it
4. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ishaan stands in the living room. Kavita and Anil stand near him.]

Anil: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ishaan puts on his school uniform.]

Ishaan (surprised): "That's easy."

[Ishaan munches on an apple.]

Kavita: "Exactly right."

[Ishaan gulps down a glass of milk.]

Ishaan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ishaan serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Ishaan: "Oh wow!"

[Ishaan reads a storybook.]

Kavita: "What happened?"

[Ishaan talks to his father on the phone.]

Ishaan (happily): "Dad, listen!"

[Ishaan slams the door shut.]

Anil: "Careful!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Kavita and Anil stand near him.]

Kavita: "Let's begin."

[The sun rises over the village.]

Anil (gently): "Okay, Kavita."

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Kavita: "I knew it!"

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Anil: "Well done!"

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Kavita: "Hey, look at that!"

[A rainbow appears in the sky.]

Ishaan: "How beautiful!"

[The sun is blazing and Ishaan is sweating.]

Anil: "That was fun!"

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Ishaan stands by the road. Kavita and Anil stand near him.]

Kavita: "Ishaan, look over here."

[Ishaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Ishaan: "Oh wow!"

[Ishaan gets into the car.]

Ishaan: "That's easy."

[Ishaan gets on the bus.]

Ishaan (excited): "Mom, look at this."

[Ishaan gets off the school bus.]

Anil (surprised): "I'm ready!"

[Ishaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Ishaan: "What happened?"

[Ishaan pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Ishaan: "I'm ready!"

Scene 4: The park - Day

Kavita: "So, here we are!"

[Ishaan goes jogging in the park.]

Kavita: "Let's see."

[Ishaan catches the ball.]

Kavita: "I'm ready!"

[Ishaan plays cricket in the park.]

Kavita: "Okay, Ishaan."

[Ishaan swings on the swing.]

Ishaan (excited): "Mom, look at this."

[Ishaan goes down the slide.]

Ishaan: "Yes, all right."

[Ishaan does yoga on a mat.]

Kavita: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
